candidates.claim: fw-01 accepts SSH management access from the CORP subnet 192.168.30.0/24 on the corp interface, which is outside MGMT and not the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the SSH management entry for 192.168.30.0/24 on the corp interface and limit SSH to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The SSH access entry for 192.168.30.0/24 on fw-01 is an addition that is not present in the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against its change record, or revert it to the approved baseline.
